info.name: FlareMinds Billing API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for every FlareMinds Billing API endpoint.

Setup:
1. Start the backend and import this collection plus the optional local environment.
2. Set adminEmail/adminPassword collection variables to match the seeded admin.
3. Run Authentication > Login first; it stores the bearer token automatically.
4. Create a client before invoices or quotations; created IDs are saved automatically.

The collection targets {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:5000/api). The same routes are also mounted under /billing; change baseUrl to http://localhost:5000/billing if needed.

Notes:
- Email/WhatsApp requests return 200 when sent, 400 for missing/invalid recipient data, and 502 when the provider is not configured or rejects the request. The quotation WhatsApp 502 response includes a manual shareLink.
- PDF requests return application/pdf and are rate limited.
- Lifecycle requests change state. Accept/reject are mutually exclusive, and only accepted quotations can be converted. Cleanup requests tolerate 409 when the record is protected.
- Quotation totals, numbers, statuses, sent logs and conversion links are server-owned and ignored if sent in a body.

item.name: 01 - System
item.description: Liveness endpoints. These do not require authentication.

request.description: GET /api/health. Returns { status: "ok" }.
GET /billing/health. Legacy alias of the API health endpoint.
GET /health. Returns service metadata, version and uptime.

item.name: 02 - Authentication
item.description: Admin authentication. Login stores the token in the collection variable used by every protected request.

request.description: POST /auth/login. Public. Body: { email, password }. Returns { token, admin: { email, name } }. The token is saved automatically.
GET /auth/me. Requires bearer token. Returns the authenticated admin's email and name.

item.name: 03 - Clients
item.description: Client CRUD. Create runs first and saves clientId, clientEmail and clientWhatsapp for later requests.

request.description: GET /clients. Returns all clients sorted by newest first.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman Test Customer",
  "company": "Acme Industries",
  "address": "12 Example Street, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600001",
  "email": "{{clientEmail}}",
  "whatsapp": "{{clientWhatsapp}}",
  "phone": "+91 98765 43210",
  "gstn": "33ABCDE1234F1Z5",
  "notes": "Created by the Postman collection.",
  "isActive": true
}

request.description: POST /clients. Body accepts name (required, min 2 chars), company, address, email, whatsapp, phone, gstn, notes, isActive. Returns 201 with the client; its _id is saved as clientId.
GET /clients/:id. Returns 404 for malformed or missing IDs.

request.description: PUT /clients/:id. Partial updates are allowed; only writable fields are accepted. Returns the updated client.

item.name: 04 - Invoices
item.description: Invoice CRUD, PDF, email and WhatsApp. Create runs first and saves invoiceId and invoiceNumber.

query.description: Optional. draft | sent | paid | overdue | cancelled

request.description: GET /invoices. Optional query: status and client. Returns all invoices (client populated) newest first.

POST /invoices. Required: client and at least one line item. Optional: date (defaults now), dueDate (must be after date), taxPercent 0-100, notes. Line items need description, quantity >= 1, rate >= 0, and optional category (digital-marketing | development | other). Number and totals are computed server-side. Returns 201.
GET /invoices/:id. Returns the invoice with its client populated.

PUT /invoices/:id. Allowed fields: client, date, dueDate, lineItems, taxPercent, notes, status (draft | sent | paid | overdue | cancelled). Totals are recalculated server-side. Returns the updated invoice.
GET /invoices/:id/pdf. Streams an inline PDF. Rate limited to 60 requests per 15 minutes per IP. Returns 409 if the client no longer exists.

POST /invoices/:id/send-email. Body: { to } optional; defaults to the client's email. Returns 400 for missing/invalid email, 409 if the client is missing, and 502 if SMTP fails. Successful delivery sets a draft invoice to sent.

POST /invoices/:id/send-whatsapp. Body: { to } optional; defaults to the client's WhatsApp number. Bare 10-digit Indian numbers are prefixed with 91. Returns 400 for invalid numbers, 409 if the client is missing, and 502 with a shareLink fallback when the Cloud API fails.

item.name: 05 - Quotations
item.description: Quotation CRUD, PDF, delivery and lifecycle. Create runs first and saves quotationId and quotationNumber. Accept before Convert; Reject is mutually exclusive with Accept.

query.description: Matches quotation number, client name or company.
draft | sent | accepted | rejected | expired | converted

request.description: GET /quotations. Paginated with per-status stats. Optional filters: search, status, client, issueFrom, issueTo. Returns { data, total, page, pages, stats }.

request.description: POST /quotations. Required: client, validUntil and at least one line item. Optional: issueDate (defaults now, cannot be in the future), currency, shippingCharges, notes, termsAndConditions, paymentTerms, deliveryTimeline, warrantyTerms, exclusions. Line items accept description, category, itemType, unit, quantity > 0, unitPrice >= 0, discountType (none | percent | amount), discountValue, taxPercent 0-100. Returns 201; number and totals are server-owned.
GET /quotations/:id. Returns the quotation with its client populated and the historical clientSnapshot.

request.description: PUT /quotations/:id. Only draft quotations can be edited. Same writable fields as create; totals are recalculated. Returns 409 when the quotation is no longer a draft and 400 when the validity date is in the past.
GET /quotations/:id/pdf. Streams an inline PDF. Rate limited to 60 requests per 15 minutes per IP.

POST /quotations/:id/send-email. Body: { to } optional; defaults to client email then snapshot email. Only draft/sent and unexpired quotations can be sent. Returns 400 for missing/invalid email, 409 for wrong status or expiry, and 502 if SMTP fails. Successful delivery sets a draft to sent.

POST /quotations/:id/send-whatsapp. Body: { to } optional; defaults to client WhatsApp then snapshot WhatsApp. Only draft/sent and unexpired quotations can be sent. Returns 400 for invalid numbers, 409 for wrong status or expiry, and 502 with a manual shareLink when the Cloud API fails.

POST /quotations/:id/accept. Body: { note } optional (max 500 chars). Only draft/sent and unexpired quotations can be accepted. Returns { message, quotation }; repeated acceptance returns 200 with the already-accepted quotation.

exec: pm.test("Quotation accepted or already accepted", function () {

request.description: POST /quotations/:id/reject. Body: { note } or { reason } optional. Only draft/sent quotations can be rejected; expired quotations may still be rejected. Returns 200 with the updated quotation, or 409 when its status no longer allows rejection (for example after acceptance).

exec: pm.test("Quotation rejected or status conflict", function () {

request.description: POST /quotations/:id/convert-to-invoice. No body. Only accepted quotations convert. Creates a draft invoice using invoice numbering/totals and marks the quotation converted. Returns 201 on first conversion, 200 with the same invoice on retries, and 409 for wrong status, mixed per-line tax rates, a missing client, or a concurrent conversion. Line items with mixed tax rates must be invoiced manually.

exec: pm.test("Quotation converted or idempotent retry", function () {

item.name: 06 - Cleanup (optional)
item.description: Delete requests. They tolerate 409 when records are protected (for example a converted quotation or a client with invoices/quotations).

request.description: DELETE /invoices/:id. Deletes an invoice. Use convertedInvoiceId or invoiceId as appropriate. Returns { message } or 404.
DELETE /quotations/:id. Only draft or rejected quotations can be deleted; accepted/converted quotations return 409. Numbers are never reused.
DELETE /clients/:id. Refused with 409 while the client has invoices or quotations. Returns { message } when deleted.
